definitions.gloss: here and there; in places; in some parts
definitions.explanation: Scattered in various locations, not uniformly distributed. Indicates partial or sporadic occurrence.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}が{所々|ところどころ}{剥|は}げている。
examples.english: The wall is peeling here and there.

examples.japanese: {所々|ところどころ}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there.

examples.japanese: {文章|ぶんしょう}に{所々|ところどころ}{間違|まちが}いがある。
examples.english: There are mistakes in places throughout the text.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}が{所々|ところどころ}{工事中|こうじちゅう}で、なかなか{前|まえ}に{進|すす}めなかった。
examples.english: The road was under construction in places, so I couldn't make much progress.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}の{季節|きせつ}になると、{山|やま}が{所々|ところどころ}{赤|あか}く{色|いろ}づいて{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: When autumn comes, the mountains turn red here and there and look beautiful.

notes:
WRITING: Also written as {処々|ところどころ} or in hiragana.

USAGE: Describes something that appears irregularly or in scattered locations, not everywhere but in various spots.

PATTERNS:
・{所々|ところどころ}に (in various places)
・{所々|ところどころ} + verb/adjective (here and there)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・あちこち (here and there - more random)
・{方々|ほうぼう} (all around, everywhere)
・{点々|てんてん}と (dotted here and there)

NOTE: The reduplication emphasizes the scattered, sporadic nature.
